texts.r:skill:e.e1.alpha: Kalmomi suna da sauƙin tunawa idan ka san sautinsu na farko da harafinsu na farko. Faɗi sautukan da ƙarfi yayin da kake karantawa.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.greet: Idan ka haɗu da wani, ka ce **Sannu**. Idan za ka tafi, ka ce **Sai anjima**. Ka faɗi sunanka da **Sunana ...**.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.numcol: Koyi kalmomin lambobi kamar ɗaya, biyu, uku... da kalmomin launuka kamar ja, shuɗi, rawaya...
texts.r:skill:e.e1.family: uwa (mama), uba (baba), kaka mace (kaka), jariri (ƙaramin yaro): waɗannan kalmomi ne na mutanen iyalinka.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.class: tebur, kujera, jaka, fensir, littafi... Faɗi sunayen abubuwan da ke aji da Turanci.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.noun: Kalmomin da ke sanya wa abubuwa suna, kamar rabbit (dabba mai dogayen kunnuwa), bird (dabbar da ke tashi) da fish (dabbar da ke iyo), ana kiransu **sunaye**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.verb: Kalmomin da ke nuna aiki, kamar jump (tsalle sama), run (gudu da sauri) da eat (cin abinci), ana kiransu **aikatau**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.like: **I like ...** na nufin kana jin daɗin wani abu. **I have ...** na nufin wani abu naka ne.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.sent: Bayan I, yi amfani da **am**. Bayan You, yi amfani da **are**. Tsarin jimla shi ne: 'wa → yadda yake / abin da yake yi'.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.read: Lokacin karatu, da farko nemo kalmomin da ke cikin tambaya a rubutun.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.build: Tsarin jimla shi ne: 'wa → ya yi → me'. Bayan He, She ko sunan mutum, ƙara **-s** ga aikatau.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.pron: A maimakon suna, za ka iya amfani da **He**, **She**, **It**, **They** ko **We**.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.tense: Ga abubuwan da ke faruwa yanzu ko akai-akai, yi amfani da **present**. Ga abubuwan da suka riga suka faru, yi amfani da **past**: ƙara **-ed** a ƙarshen aikatau.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.routine: tashi, goge haƙora, cin karin kumallo, kwanciya barci... Faɗi ayyukan yau da kullum da Turanci.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.read: Karanta rubutun ka gano wanda ya yi me, kuma yaushe.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.abc1: Haruffa suna da **manyan haruffa** da **ƙananan haruffa**. Biyu da yawa suna bambanta, saboda haka koya su bibbiyu. Kula sosai da haruffa masu kama, kamar b, d, p da q.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.snd1: Sautin farko na kalma yana da alaƙa da harafinta na farko. Nemo kalmomin da ke farawa da sauti ɗaya domin koyon alaƙar sauti da rubutu. Wani lokaci haruffa biyu, kamar ph, suna yin sautin f.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.tense: Ga yanzu ko halaye, yi amfani da **present**. Ga abin da ya wuce, ƙara **-ed**. Ga abubuwan da za ka yi, yi amfani da **will + tushen aikatau**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.qneg: Fara tambaya da **Do/Does**. Don nuna ƙin yarda, yi amfani da **don't/doesn't**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.adj: Kalmomi kamar big, small, hot da cold suna bayyana yadda abu yake ko yadda ake ji.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.prep: Yi amfani da **on**, **in**, **under** da **behind** don faɗin inda abubuwa suke.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.read: Nemo wanda ya yi me da kuma inda a cikin rubutu, sannan ka amsa.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.gram: Yi amfani da **an** kafin sautin wasali, da **a** kafin sautin baƙin harafi. Ga abu guda, yi amfani da **There is**. Ga abubuwa da yawa, yi amfani da **There are**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.comp: Don kwatanta abubuwa biyu, yi amfani da **-er + than**. Don 'mafi', yi amfani da **the -est**. Ga dogayen kalmomi, yi amfani da **more**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.future: Ga abubuwan da za ka yi, yi amfani da **will + tushen aikatau** ko **be going to + tushen aikatau**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.transform: Don jimlolin ƙin yarda, yi amfani da **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Don tambaya, sanya **Are / Do / Does** a farkon jimla.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.read: Dogayen rubutu sun fi sauƙi idan ka nemo wa, ina, yaushe da me, kamar kana ja musu layi.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.tense: Ga abubuwan da ke faruwa yanzu, yi amfani da **be + -ing**. Ga abin da ya wuce, yi amfani da **past tense**. Ga nan gaba, yi amfani da **will / be going to**.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.modal: **can** (iya), **must** (dole), **should** (yana da kyau a), **may** (an yarda a) suna zuwa kafin tushen aikatau.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.vocab: Koyi kalmomin masu kama da ma'ana da kishiyoyinsu tare, kuma ƙamus ɗinka zai ninku.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.read: Karanta rubutu mai jimloli da yawa ka gano wanda ya yi abu, yaushe da kuma me ya sa.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.seq1: Kalmomin da ke nuna jerin abubuwa, kamar **First**, **Then / Next**, **After that** da **Finally**, suna nuna jerin yadda abubuwa suka faru.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.pun1: Jimla tana farawa da **babban harafi** kuma tana ƙarewa da **alamar rubutu** da ta dace: aya (.) ga sanarwa, alamar tambaya (?) ga tambaya, alamar motsin rai (!) ga mamaki ko tsananin ji. Sunayen mutane da kalmar I koyaushe ana rubuta su da babban harafi.
texts.r:skill:e.vocab: Koyi kalmomin gama-gari tare da **sauti + ma'ana + rubutun kalma** kuma za ka daɗe kana tunawa da su. Taɓa maɓallin lasifika don jin yadda ake furta su.
texts.r:skill:e.be: Sigar aikatau be tana canzawa bisa ga mai aikatawa. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
texts.r:skill:e.pres: Idan mai aikatawa shi ne **he / she / it (mutum na uku, tilo)**, ƙara **-s / -es** ga aikatau. Kalmomin da ke ƙarewa da -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o suna ɗaukar -es. Idan baƙin harafi + y, sauya y zuwa i sannan ƙara -es!
texts.r:skill:e.plural: Ga abubuwa biyu ko fiye, yawanci a ƙara **-s** ga suna. Sunayen da ke ƙarewa da -x suna ɗaukar **-es**. Ka haddace jam'in da ba na ka'ida ba. Tsarin jimla shi ne **mai aikatawa → aikatau → sauran kalmomi**.
texts.r:skill:e.order: Ga abubuwa biyu ko fiye, yawanci a ƙara **-s** ga suna. Sunayen da ke ƙarewa da -x suna ɗaukar **-es**. Ka haddace jam'in da ba na ka'ida ba. Tsarin jimla shi ne **mai aikatawa → aikatau → sauran kalmomi**.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.perf: have/has + past participle. Yana nuna gogewa, kammalawa ko ci gaba. Bambanta since (lokacin farawa) da for (tsawon lokaci).
texts.r:skill:e.m2.pass: Yi amfani da be + past participle don faɗin cewa an yi wani abu ga mutum ko abu. Ƙara wanda ya yi aikin da by.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.inf: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V yana nuna manufa, stop + V-ing kuma yana nufin dakatar da aiki.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.comp: -er/-est da more/most. Yi amfani da than tare da siffofin kwatantawa, da the tare da siffofin fifiko. good → better → best ba ya bin ƙa'ida.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.read: Karanta tambayar da farko, sannan nemo jimlar alama. Take da babban ra'ayi sun shafi dukan rubutun.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.sum1: Don taƙaitawa, nemo **babban ra'ayi** sannan ka taƙaita shi zuwa jimla ɗaya ko biyu. Jimlar bayani guda ɗaya kawai, wadda ta ƙara abin da ba ya cikin rubutun, ko wadda ta yi faɗi da yawa ba ta zama kyakkyawar taƙaitawa ba.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.rel: Haɗa jimloli biyu zuwa ɗaya da who (mutane), which (abubuwa), that (duka biyun) da whose (mallaka).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.cond: If + present, will + V (abu mai yiwuwa). If + past, would + V (hasashen wani abu da ba gaskiya ba ne yanzu).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.ques: Yi amfani da tsarin kalmar tambaya + mai aikatawa + aikatau. Kada a yi amfani da do/does/did.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.part: -ing yana nuna aiki mai aikatawa ko mai gudana; -ed yana nuna abin da aka yi masa ko wanda ya kammala. Ga ji, yi amfani da -ing ga abin da ke jawo jin, da -ed ga mutumin da yake ji.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.read: Haɗa alamomi domin yin hasashe. Yanke shawarar manufar rubutu ta duba buƙatunsa da da'awoyinsa.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.tense: had + p.p. na nuna abin da ya faru kafin wani abu a baya. have been -ing na nuna aikin da ya ci gaba har zuwa yanzu.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.clause: where / when / why kalmomin dangantaka ne masu aiki kamar bayanau. whether / that suna gabatar da jimlolin suna.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.partc: Cire kalmar haɗi da mai aikatawa, sannan sauya aikatau zuwa -ing. Mai aikatawa dole ya zama ɗaya a sassan biyu.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.conn: Bambanta dalili da sakamako (so, therefore), saɓani (however), misalai (for example) da ƙari (in addition).
texts.r:skill:e.h1.main: Babban ra'ayi yakan zo bayan However, wanda ke juya ra'ayi gama-gari, da kuma a jimlar ƙarshe. Cika gurbi ta bin jerin matsala → mafita → sakamako.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.inv: Idan Never/Hardly/Only then ya zo a farko, tsarin yana zama auxiliary + subject. Yi amfani da It is ~ that don jaddadawa.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.subj: A cikin jimlolin I wish / as if / If, yi amfani da lokacin baya don abin da ya saba wa yanzu, da had p.p. don abin da ya saba wa baya.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.wh: whatever, whoever, whichever da however + adjective suna nufin 'ko me / wa / wanne / yaya ...'.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.vocab: Yi hasashen ma'anar sabuwar kalma daga alamomin saɓani, misali da dalili, da kuma daga kari a farkon kalma.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.logic: Bi rubutun ta la'akari da abin da kalmomin nuni ke wakilta da kalmomin haɗi. Tattara bayanai domin kai ga ƙarshe.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.par: Jimlolin da and/but/or suka haɗa suna ɗaukar tsari iri ɗaya. Aikatau yana dacewa da babban mai aikatawa.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.tone: Gano yanayi daga kalmomin bayani da motsin rai. Gano manufar ta duba ko rubutun yana tambaya, bayar da bayani ko rinjayarwa.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.ins: Yi amfani da kalmomin haɗi, na nuni da jerin lokaci a matsayin alamomi don jera jimloli da nemo inda jimlar da aka bayar ta dace.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.col: Koyi kalmomi biyu da ake yawan haɗawa, kamar make a decision, take a risk da heavy rain. Yi hasashen ma'anar karin magana daga yanayinta.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.sum: Nemo muhimmin ra'ayi da kalmomin saɓani a cikin rubutu, sannan a taƙaita su zuwa jimla ɗaya.
texts.r:skill:e.h.conv: A tambayoyin tattaunawa, duba ba daidaiwar nahawu kaɗai ba, har ma ko salon ya yi na halitta da ladabi a yanayin. Bayarwa, katse magana, amsa yabo, karin magana da zance kai tsaye sukan taso akai-akai.
texts.r:skill:e.h.job: A Turancin wurin aiki, muhimman abubuwa su ne karin magana (touch base), gajerun kalmomi (ASAP da sauransu) da haɗin fi’ili da harafin dangantaka (collocations). Kada ka fassara kalma da kalma; ka haddace su a matsayin gungu da ake amfani da su a wurin aiki.
texts.r:skill:e.h.media: A Turancin kafofin watsa labarai, yana da muhimmanci a bambanta gaskiya da ra’ayi kuma a tantance ko hujjar da ke goyon bayan da’awa tana da inganci. Ka tuna da kalmomi kamar bayanin hoto (alt text, caption) da kayan gyara bisa amfaninsu.
texts.r:skill:e.h.world: A batutuwan al’adun duniya, koyi muhimman kalmomi kamar al’ada, bambance-bambance da ra’ayin son kai, da furucin ƙoƙarin fahimtar wasu al’adu ba tare da hukunta su ba. Bambanta kalmomin da suka yi kama ta amfani da alamun mahalli.
texts.r:skill:e.h.lit: A tambayoyin adabi, muhimmin abu shi ne sanin ma’anar kalma da amfani da ita ga wani yanayi a labari. Bambanta alamar abin da zai faru nan gaba, alama, mahangar labari, jigo da matsayin jarumai.
texts.r:skill:e.h.debate: Muhawara na bukatar bambance kalmomi (motion, rebuttal da sauransu), nau’o’in hujja da kuskuren tunani. Yayin tantance da’awa, fara da tambaya, “Wace hujja ce ke goyon bayanta?”
texts.r:skill:e.h.write: A rubutu, zaɓi salo da ya dace da manufar da mai karatu, sannan duba sassan jimla (mai aikatau da fi’ili) da ma’anar masu haɗa jimloli. A takardu na musamman kamar CV, ayyuka da lambobi sun fi kalmomi marasa takamaiman ma’ana.

texts.why:eb-1387413b-q1: Mina ta ce, “Ƙungiyoyi 3 sun riga sun zaɓi wannan,” saboda haka ta ƙi shi domin sauran ƙungiyoyi sun riga sun zaɓi wannan batu.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q2: Mina ta ce watakila alkalan su gaji, kuma ta fi son batu “mai ban mamaki”, saboda haka za mu iya fahimtar cewa Mina tana son aikin da zai bambanta da sauran.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q3: Faɗin cewa matatar ruwa ta fi aman wuta “ban mamaki” na nufin ba abu ne da aka saba gani ba.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q4: Bayan an ƙi ra’ayin aman wuta, Joon ya faɗi wannan domin ya ba da shawarar wani zaɓi.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q5: A ƙarshe, Mina ta ce, “Zan yi jerin abubuwa yau da dare.”
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q1: Abel ya ce, “Kowannenmu yana da dala 10 kawai.” Dala 20 su ne jimillar kuɗinsu tare.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q2: Jun ya dade yana gwada sabbin girke-girke, saboda haka za ka iya gane cewa Jun yana sha’awar girki.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q3: Ma’anarsa ita ce littafin girki kyauta ce mai kyau da ke nuna sun yi tunani game da Jun.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q4: Lena ta faɗi haka domin ta nuna cewa suna da dala 20 tare, wanda ya isa su sayi littafin da farashinsa dala 18.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q5: A ƙarshe Lena ta ce, “Da farko zan duba lokutan buɗewar shagon.”
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q1: Jisu ta ce ciyawar da ta jiku ba ta da daɗi, kuma sandwiches ɗin za su jiku.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q2: Ben ya ce, “Zan kira in yi ajiyar wuri yau,” saboda haka za ka iya gane cewa dole ne a fara yin ajiyar ɗakin.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q3: An faɗi wannan ne domin amsa dalilin Jisu kafin a ba da wani zaɓi; saboda haka “To, na fahimta” na nufin yarda da ra’ayin ɗayan.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q4: “Ai ko kaɗan” furuci ne na nuna tsananin rashin amincewa da shawarar sokewa.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q5: Ben ya ce, “Zan kira in yi ajiyar wuri yau.” Sanar da sauran mutanen aikin Jisu ne.
texts.why:eb-d512193c-q1: Sora ta ce, “Ina da darasin piano da safe.”
texts.why:eb-d512193c-q2: Za su tashi da kites a “filin shakatawa na bakin kogi”.
texts.why:eb-d512193c-q3: Jun ya gaya wa Sora ta zo da kwalbar ruwa kawai. An riga an tanadar wa Sora kite.
texts.why:eb-d512193c-q4: Sun yarda su haɗu da ƙarfe 2.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q1: Ma’aikacin shagon ya ce “ruwa mai tsabta kowane mako.” Sau 2 a rana shi ne yawan ciyar da kifin.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q2: Sora ta damu cewa kula da tanki aiki ne mai yawa, kuma ta ce za ta fara da kifin da ya dace da mafari; saboda haka za mu iya fahimtar cewa ba ta taɓa kiwon kifi ba.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q3: A nan, kifin zinariya ya dace da mutanen da suka fara kiwon kifi, don haka “masu farawa” na nufin mutanen da suke fara koyon abin.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q4: Ta hanyar tambayar sau nawa ake kula da kifin, Sora tana son sanin yawan aikin da ake bukata.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q5: A ƙarshe ma’aikacin shagon ya ce, “Bari in nemo maka ƙaramin tanki.”
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q1: Noah ya ce, “Ya fi sauri, kuma kyauta ne.”
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q2: Shigar da rigar ruwan sama cikin kaya “ko da yake” na nuna cewa Noah yana ganin watakila za a yi ruwa, amma bai da tabbaci.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q3: A nan, idan ruwan sama ya sauko sosai za ka jiƙe “sosai”, wato jikinka zai jiku ƙwarai.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q4: “If I were you” wata magana ce da ake amfani da ita wajen ba wa wani shawara.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q5: Ella ta ce, “Text me when you arrive,” saboda haka wataƙila Noah zai aika wa Ella saƙo idan ya isa.
